_doc: LoopStar music-video looks (iOS, Phase VFX 2026-10-10). Each look maps the music LoopStar already knows (kicks, snares, bars, song sections, chords) to effects on the filmed video. The app knows only the effect kinds; every amount, timing and section word lives here, so a look ships without a rebuild. Missing fields are off. Times are milliseconds. punch.kick/snare = extra zoom on each hit; pushIn.perBar/max = slow zoom into a section; impact = a hit on sections whose label contains one of `sections` (whole words, any case); flash = exposure flash on hits, capped by maxPerSecond (the app never allows more than 3/s, WCAG 2.3.1); rgbSplit.pixels at 1080 px wide; grade.warmth in Kelvin (+ warmer); text toggles the title card (project name, first 2 s), section callouts, the chord pill and the BPM/key badge. Bundled fallback: mchatai/mChatAI/mChatAI/LoopStar/Resources/loopstar_video_looks_fallback.json (keep equal; a test checks).

looks.name: Plain
looks.blurb: The video as you filmed it.

looks.name: Hype
looks.blurb: Punch-ins on the beat, a hit on the chorus or drop, bold callouts.

looks.name: Chill
looks.blurb: Warm and soft, a gentle drift in, a little breath on the kick.

looks.name: Glitch
looks.blurb: Colour splits on the snare, hard punches, neon grade.

looks.name: Cinematic
looks.blurb: A slow push, a big swell into the chorus, film colour.

looks.name: B&W
looks.blurb: Black and white with a kick in the frame.
